subject: Greed Hole 1

evidence.quote:
「貪欲なる坑窟2」で中ボスビショップリザードマン（ちょっとでかめのリザードマン）とバトル  
  
バトルに勝つと「貪欲なる抗窟1」のオブジェクトが解放し、「敗者達の峡谷」へ行ける様になる
evidence.translation: Battle mid-boss Bishop Lizardman in Greed Hole 2; winning the battle releases the object in Greed Hole 1, allowing access to Losers' Canyon.

subject: NM Crimson Spinner
text: In Predator's Pilgrimage Road, battle NM Crimson Spinner listed in the boss strategy info.

evidence.quote: 「捕食者の巡礼路」でボス攻略情報[check](check.html)に載っている**NMクリムゾンスピナー** とバトル
evidence.translation: Battle NM Crimson Spinner listed in the boss strategy info check in Predator's Pilgrimage Road.

subject: Small Slime
text: Small slime in Corridor of Battlefield can be defeated in one hit with only Step-In.

evidence.quote: 「戦域の回廊」の小さいスライムはステップインのみで一撃で倒せる
evidence.translation: The small slime in Corridor of Battlefield can be defeated in one hit with only Step-In.

subject: Cauldron of Death 1F
text: Cauldron of Death branches on the 1st floor, where advancing to the 2nd floor from the right connects to the 3rd floor route.

evidence.quote: 「死者の大釜」は1階のみ分岐があり、右方向から2階に進むと3階に繋がるルートとなる
evidence.translation: Cauldron of Death only has a branch on 1st floor; advancing to 2nd floor from the right direction connects to the 3rd floor route.

subject: Cauldron of Death 4F
text: Cauldron of Death 4th floor is only the passageway before the boss room, and arriving at the boss room entrance returns the player to town for battle preparation.

evidence.quote: 「死者の大釜」4階はボス部屋前の通路のみでボス部屋入口に着くと決戦準備のため街に戻される
evidence.translation: Cauldron of Death 4th floor is only the passageway before the boss room, and arriving at the boss room entrance returns the player to town for battle preparation.

subject: Ragneck
text: Ragneck in Poison Weave Forest is a strong enemy, so prepare by raising levels on upper floors or your partner will die immediately.

evidence.quote:
※76層の攻略途中から行ける様になる毒織りの森にいるラグネック(巨大サソリ)は  
かなり強敵なので上層でレベルを上げるなど準備を整えてから挑まないとパートナーが  
すぐに死んでしまうので注意
evidence.translation: Note: Ragneck in Poison Weave Forest is a strong enemy, so prepare by raising levels on upper floors or your partner will die immediately.

subject: Ghastly Gaze

evidence.quote:
・邪眼による様々な状態異常攻撃が厄介でスタンや麻痺など動けなく攻撃をしてくる

evidence.translation: Status ailment attacks from evil eye like stun and paralysis prevent movement, and it unleashes an all-direction attack after taking damage.

text: Weapons in dungeon treasure chests have randomized names, stats, effects, and enhancement counts, and some chests yield the same weapon type currently equipped by Kirito or his partner.

evidence.quote: ※ダンジョンにある宝箱に入っている武器はランダムで名前が決まり、武器ステータスや効果、強化回数も若干変動するため、ここでは武器宝箱ABC・・・と表記している。ちなみに宝箱の中には開く時にキリトもしくはパートナーが装備している種類の武器と 同種類の武器が出現するものもある

subject: Dragon Breaking Sword
text: NM Flare Dragon in Forest Inhabited by Dragons cannot be fought without Dragon Breaking Sword; after seeing the dragon, speak to the NPC in Abandoned Wisdom Cave, defeat Iron Golem in Confusing Rock Cave for Dragon Breaking Stone, and the NPC crafts Dragon Breaking Sword.

evidence.quote:
右：「竜の棲む森」には[check](check.html)に載る**NMフレアドラゴン** がいるが【竜破剣】がないと戦えない  
左：「打ち捨てられた知恵の洞」の奥のNPCにドラゴンに会った後話しかけると奥にある  
「混迷の岩洞」に進めるようになる  
  
「混迷の岩洞」の奥にいるアイアンゴーレムを倒して【竜破石】をゲットしNPCに持っていくと  
【竜破剣】を作ってくれる
evidence.translation: NM Flare Dragon in Forest Inhabited by Dragons cannot be fought without Dragon Breaking Sword; after seeing the dragon, speak to the NPC in Abandoned Wisdom Cave, defeat Iron Golem in Confusing Rock Cave for Dragon Breaking Stone, and the NPC crafts Dragon Breaking Sword.

evidence.quote: 再度「竜の棲む森」に向かいフレアドラゴンを倒すと78層迷宮区「悪鬼の魔窟」に行ける
evidence.translation: Heading again to Forest Inhabited by Dragons and defeating Flare Dragon allows going to Floor 78 Labyrinth Demons' Cave.

evidence.translation: Boss name: Madness Horn Effective attribute: Slash

subject: Madness Horn
text: Lower stats with debuff skills against Madness Horn buffs, parry to cause Risk Break, watch party HP against wide axe attacks, and expect continuous combo attacks when boss HP is low.

evidence.quote:
・強化系のスキルを発動してくるので弱体化系スキルで敵のステータスを下げよう  
・打撃のモーションが長いのでバリィ回避系のスキルが有効  
・またパリング等でリスクブレイクを狙いやすい  
・斧は広範囲にあたるので他パーティーのHPもケアしよう  
・序盤は手こずらないがHPが少なくなると怒涛の連撃をしてくるので終盤が勝負になる
evidence.translation: Lower stats with debuff skills against Madness Horn buffs, parry to cause Risk Break, watch party HP against wide axe attacks, and expect continuous combo attacks when boss HP is low.
